corrections.text: The article cites the Herald's earlier report that LMCache had 'no fixed version as of October 7.' That status is dated: the LMCache GitHub security advisory GHSA-w5f2-9q9c-ff4h (published October 13, 2026) lists CVE-2026-105192 as affecting lmcache versions >= 0.3.9 and < 0.5.6, with 0.5.6 as the patched version, and 0.5.6 was released on PyPI on October 15. Neither the post nor the cookbook cited here addresses this.

The article describes the post's authors as the project's own contributors. The post is published on valkey.io, and its author biographies identify Chaitanya Nuthalapati and Jeff Duffy as product managers on the Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey team at AWS; Omer Rubinstein is described as a software engineer working on Valkey.
